Hi there, we’re Article. 👋 Since 2013, we have been redefining the furniture industry one sofa at a time, it’s not easy — it requires solving challenging, meaningful problems. This is where you come in. As a Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack, you'll design, build, deploy, and operate software solutions across our entire technology stack to help power our digital and physical customer experiences.

*We are currently seeking out 1 permanent and 4 one year term positions

Why We Need You: In Software Engineering, we need experienced full-stack talent who can own solutions end-to-end rather than specializing in a single layer. This fits into our larger need to translate complex business problems into simple, reliable, and scalable software that drives our growing omni-channel retail operations.

Why Article? As a Particle (people of Article), you will have a high level of autonomy to solve challenging, meaningful problems the best way you can. That means you’re trusted to explore solutions you believe will work best (you’re the expert, after all). You’ll do all this while growing your skills within a company that is redefining the furniture industry.

About the Software Engineering team: You'll join a highly competent engineering team of 8 software engineers as part of a broader department of roughly 30 tech professionals, reporting to the Sr. Manager of Software Engineering. We work across frontend applications, backend services, databases, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. 

We are a modern, adaptable engineering organization built around micro-sized squads (typically 1–2 engineers) with full-stack ownership. We use Claude AI to understand complex codebases fast and skip dense documentation.

We are a hybrid team - you'll be in the office 3 days per week.
data.key_responsibilities:
What You’ll Do: You’ll be part of a team of software engineers working to solve complex technical and business challenges across our entire platform.
  • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate complete software solutions across frontend, backend, and data pipelines.
  • Develop customer-facing and internal web applications primarily using Vue.js, TypeScript, and React.
  • Build backend applications, APIs, integrations, and services using Java.
  • Design relational and NoSQL data models, event-driven workflows, and scalable service architectures.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines using Python, SQL, dbt, and Databricks.
  • Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure on platforms like AWS, leveraging DynamoDB and Kafka.
  • Build automated tests and CI/CD pipelines while monitoring, troubleshooting, and improving production systems.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Designers, and business stakeholders to translate needs into incremental releases.
  • Contribute to technical design, code reviews, engineering standards, and address technical debt to protect system health.

Additional Requirements:
  • Legally able to work in Canada.
  • Completion of a criminal background check.

Hi there, we’re Article. 👋  Since 2013, we have been redefining the furniture industry one sofa at a time, it’s not easy — it requires solving challenging, meaningful problems. This is where you come in, as a Senior Manager, Global Sourcing, you’ll connect global category strategy to regional execution, maximizing product margins, strengthening our supply base, and leading sourcing operations across North America and Vietnam.

Why We Need You:

Our Global Sourcing team connects Article’s category strategy with the regional teams and vendor partners who bring our products to life. The Senior Manager, Global Sourcing serves as a Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Article's internal customers, including Category Management, Product Design, Technical Product Development and Quality Assurance, and provides leadership to the Sourcing operations teams in North America and Vietnam.

Strategically positioned to link global category strategy to regional operational execution, this role holds immediate accountability for maximizing product margins, driving global category procurement plans, finalizing cost grids, and managing product and vendor allocations.

The position is designed to decouple category strategy from daily vendor management, enabling regional back-office teams in Vietnam and Mexico to specialize in factory-facing, day-to-day execution. You’ll act as a high-value "quarterback" for the business, driving footprint diversification, mitigating single points of failure and monopolization risks, and actively engineering solutions to regional bottlenecks during local North American business hours.

We are currently hiring for two Senior Managers, Global Sourcing.

Why Article?

As a Particle (people of Article), you will have a high level of autonomy to solve challenging, meaningful problems the best way you can. That means you’re trusted to explore solutions you believe will work best (you’re the expert, after all). You’ll do all this while growing your skills within a company that is redefining the furniture industry.

About the Global Sourcing Team:

You’ll provide leadership to sourcing operations teams across Asia and North America, including Sourcing Managers and Specialists in our regional hubs.

Our regional teams work closely with Article’s Product Engine and vendor partners to turn category strategies into strong commercial and operational outcomes. You’ll help create clarity across these groups while ensuring regional teams have the direction and decision-making boundaries they need to execute effectively.

We are a hybrid team. You'll be in our Vancouver HQ a minimum of 3 days per week, with up to 2 days per week working from home. Schedule requirements may evolve according to business needs.
data.key_responsibilities:
Global Category Strategy & Internal Business Partnering
  • Serve as the primary strategic point of contact (SPOC) for the Category Management Team to drive cross-functional sourcing strategies and help deliver catalog expansion.
  • Translate high-level commercial briefs and needs into actionable global category procurement plans.
  • Own and run the Category Positioning Matrix annually to balance business impact scores against supply market risks across the category portfolio.
  • Coordinate the end-to-end commercialization calendar across the value chain, ensuring strict alignment of New Product Introductions (NPI) and Supply Chain Risk Reduction (SCRR) projects with brand launch milestones.
Cost Governance & Commercial Negotiations
  • Hold accountability for cost targets, manufacturing defects, and total landed-cost optimization.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations and drive Bill of Material (BOM) level visibility for better decision-making.
Footprint Diversification & Supply Chain Resilience
  • Architect and execute regional supply base diversification strategies across North America, Southeast Asia, and emerging markets to buffer Article against geopolitical disruption.
  • De-risk the category portfolio by expanding the vendor ecosystem to systematically dismantle single-source dependencies and corporate monopoly risks.
  • Work collaboratively with Product Quality to drive down the Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) by systematically reviewing, developing, or phasing out underperforming suppliers.
Regional Leadership & Bottleneck Resolution
  • Provide strategic direction, clear decision-making boundaries, and leadership to in-region back-office execution teams, including Sourcing Managers and Specialists in regional hubs.
  • Act as the immediate escalation path to unblock regional, cross-functional, and factory-level constraints during North American business hours, reducing cycle times and preventing project stagnation.
  • Review, monitor, and guide vendors on capacity constraints, including labor, tooling, facility, and raw material safety stock levels, to safeguard Article's production lead times and delivery commitments.
Supplier Performance
  • Own global vendor accountability metrics, specifically On-Time In-Full (OTIF) production, cost of product, and factory defect rates, to relentlessly drive down Article’s total Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) and protect brand integrity.

In the Sourcing Team, the Sourcing Lead (Upholstery) translates category direction into clear, actionable sourcing plans. You’ll drive supplier performance, lead negotiations, provide market and supplier insights, and serve as a key subject matter expert for Upholstery suppliers and sourcing execution.


During this 1-year maternity leave coverage, you’ll step into an established team and help maintain continuity across our Upholstery sourcing activities, supplier relationships, and cross-functional partnerships.

Why Article?


While we sell to the North American market, we work closely with a number of our manufacturing partners throughout Asia. As a result, we have an office in Thao Dien, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, where we currently have around 70 Particles (people of Article) working.

In the Category team, you'll be helping to drive what trends are rising in the furniture world and analyze which new products bring the most value to Article's customers, expanding our Living Room Upholstery assortment. Hi there, we’re Article. 👋 We’re a North American based furniture company creating remarkably better furniture experiences one sofa at a time. And as the Creative Production Manager, you’ll own the day-to-day creative production operations in Vietnam, helping bring our products to life through high-quality eCommerce photography and 3D assets.


Why We Need You:

As part of the Creative team, you’ll be the local owner of Creative Production operations in Vietnam, coordinating the end-to-end production of eCommerce creative assets, including White Background and Lifestyle photography and 3D scans.

This is an exciting opportunity to help establish and continuously improve the production operations supporting a brand-new photography studio operated by an external partner. You’ll ensure products move efficiently from our suppliers, through the studio production process, into final creative asset delivery and product disposition.

Your manager will be based in Vancouver, Canada, so this role requires a high degree of independence, ownership, and initiative. You’ll work closely with global Creative teams, Sourcing, Technical Product Development, logistics partners, and external vendors to keep production moving, solve problems proactively, and ensure projects are delivered on time and to specification.


Why Article?

What started in 2019 as a project to strengthen our relationships with our Asian vendors has grown into a permanent operation in Ho Chi Minh City. Article currently has ≈70 employees in Vietnam, across our Sourcing, Technical Product Development, Quality, HR, Logistics, PMO and Accounting functions.

As a Particle (people of Article), you will have a high level of autonomy to solve challenging, meaningful problems the best way you can. That means you’re trusted to explore solutions you believe will work best (you’re the expert, after all). You’ll do all this while growing your skills within a company that is redefining the furniture industry. 

At Article, we grow and have fun together through regular in-office training and team activities. These moments help us build connection, collaboration, and creativity across our teams all year long.
data.key_responsibilities:
You’ll take ownership of Creative Production operations in Vietnam, serving as the local point of contact and connecting our Vietnam operations with Creative teams and partners across different regions.

Creative Production Management
  • Manage the end-to-end production workflow for eCommerce creative assets, including White Background and Lifestyle photography and 3D scans, from product readiness through final asset delivery.
  • Coordinate production schedules, resourcing, and work allocation based on product priorities, production volume, team capacity, and business requirements.
  • Set projects up for success in project management software, ensuring the appropriate assignees, inputs, documentation, timelines, and project information are in place.
  • Establish clear workflows, handoffs, and communication between local production teams, global Creative teams, and external partners.
  • Ensure project requirements, priorities, timelines, and potential issues are clearly communicated and that projects are delivered on time and to specification.
  • Build strong working relationships across Photography, Creative Direction, CGI, Production Management, Technical Product Development, Inbound Logistics, Sourcing, and external partners.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert and primary point of contact for Creative Production operations in Vietnam.
  • Track production performance and identify recurring challenges, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop and continuously improve scalable processes, workflows, tools, templates, and documentation to increase production quality, efficiency, communication, and capacity.
  • Maintain regular onsite presence at the Vietnam Photo Studio in Tian Dien, located approximately 30 minutes from Article HQ, and participate in weekly meetings with international teams across PST time zones.

Product Logistics & Inventory Management
  • Coordinate product availability and readiness throughout the creative production lifecycle, including product receipt, storage, preparation, movement, return, and final disposition.
  • Maintain accurate inventory tracking and visibility of products and props to ensure items are accounted for and available according to production schedules.
  • Partner closely with Sourcing, Technical Product Development, logistics partners, and other cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve product availability, delivery, damage, defect, production, and inventory issues.
  • Establish and continuously improve processes for inventory tracking, product check-in/check-out, and sample management.
  • Conduct regular inventory audits to maintain accurate product records and proactively minimize unnecessary storage costs.
  • 20% travel required, primarily for local travel to the Vietnam Photo Studio

Budget & Vendor Management
  • Manage day-to-day creative production budgets and spend, ensuring costs remain aligned with approved budgets, agreed rates, scopes, and production requirements.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and track production-related costs, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor payments.
  • Review vendor invoices for accuracy and ensure expenses are appropriately recorded and reconciled.
  • Provide a regular budget and spend reporting to management.
  • Proactively identify potential cost overruns, communicate risks, and recommend solutions to keep production on track and within budget.
  • Build effective working relationships with external production partners and vendors to support strong service levels, efficient execution, and continuous improvement.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
• 2+ years of professional experience in creative production. Experience working in eCommerce creative production is strongly preferred.
  • You understand the high-volume, repeatable, and deadline-driven nature of eCommerce photography and its unique production workflows and deliverables.
  • Strong understanding of creative production processes, particularly photography; knowledge of 3D/CGI workflows is an asset.
  • Proven experience managing production schedules, timelines, budgets, vendors, and project deliverables.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong time-management and prioritization skills.
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to identify problems, make informed decisions, and keep projects moving with limited oversight.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with teams and stakeholders across different functions, regions, and time zones.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with both internal teams and external partners.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Experience developing or improving creative production workflows, processes, templates, tools, or workflow automation is an asset.
  • Experience in the furniture, home décor, or related industry is an asset.
  • A diploma or degree in Creative Production, Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent industry experience will also be considered.
  • Comfortable with regular local travel to the Vietnam Photo Studio and occasional meetings aligned with PST working hours.

What’s next:
  • If you’re selected to proceed in the interview process, you’ll receive emails directly from Article (email domains @article.com, article@pinpoint.email) and not through VietnamWorks

Hi there, we’re Article. 👋 We’re an online first furniture company creating remarkably better furniture experiences, one sofa at a time. Since 2013, we’ve been redefining the industry. Vancouver, BC is home to our HQ and first retail store, and our logistics network serves customers coast to coast across the US and Canada. This is where you come in. As our Customer Research & Insight Specialist (Marketing), you will help build, scale, and deliver Article’s Voice of Customer (VoC) engine, turning customer feedback datasets into commercial insights that directly shape business strategy and drive end to end customer retention.

Please Note (Role Profile & Contract Term): This is a 1 Year Full Time Term Contract based out of our Vancouver HQ. This position is a strategic customer research and commercial insights role—it is not a passive reporting or general Business Analyst position. We are looking for a true business partner who combines sharp business acumen with qualitative customer empathy and cross functional influence.

Why We Need You

Understanding our customers at scale is essential to delivering remarkable experiences and driving business performance. The Customer Research & Insight Specialist sits at the intersection of customer feedback and business strategy, synthesizing data across every customer touchpoint: product reviews, experience surveys, claims data, and customer care interactions into strategic intelligence.

In this role, you will do far more than generate dashboards or deliver static reports. You will act as a pragmatic business partner and passionate customer advocate who translates complex customer sentiment into tangible commercial recommendations. By owning our taxonomy frameworks, refining sentiment tools, and collaborating directly with operational leaders across Article, you will ensure the voice of the customer actively informs strategic investments, product decisions, and operational trade offs. You’ll work closely as an embedded strategic partner to leaders across Customer Care, Logistics, eCommerce, Quality, and Category Management to ensure customer sentiment directly drives operational improvements and product strategy.

Within your first few months, you’d take ownership of our customer feedback datasets in our Voice of Customer tool (Chattermill), establish strong working partnerships with key department heads, and refine our code frames to align with operational goals. In a year, you’ll be proud to say you’ve elevated our VoC engine into a core business driver, established clear cross functional alignment, and influenced key business initiatives through data backed strategic recommendations.

Why Article?

As a Particle (people of Article), you will have a high level of autonomy to solve challenging, meaningful problems the best way you can. That means you’re trusted to explore solutions you believe will work best (you’re the expert, after all). You’ll do all this while growing your career within a company that is actively scaling its commercial and direct to consumer presence. 

About the Marketing & Insights Team


You will sit within the Marketing team, reporting into the Senior Manager, Research & Insights. Our team operates at the intersection of customer experience, brand strategy, and commercial execution, serving as an embedded strategic partner to leaders across Customer Care, Logistics, eCommerce, Quality, and Category Management.

We thrive on business acumen, curiosity, clear communication, and first principles problem solving. We’re looking for someone who acts as a true consultant to internal teams, combining deep customer empathy with a sharp understanding of business drivers.

This position is based out of our Vancouver, BC HQ (Hybrid in office schedule required; remote work outside Vancouver is not supported for this role).

Hi there, we’re Article. 👋 Since 2013, we have been redefining the furniture industry one sofa at a time. It’s not easy; it requires solving challenging, meaningful problems. This is where you come in. As our Facilities Maintenance Specialist, you will design, implement, and oversee Article's multi-site facilities maintenance program across our fulfillment centers, retail stores, office environments, and future physical locations.

Why We Need You

As Article expands its retail store presence and warehousing network, keeping our physical infrastructure running safely, smoothly, and efficiently is critical. We are establishing Health, Safety & Facilities (HSF) as an independent function to support our expanding physical presence, allowing our operational leaders to focus on core business execution while you own facility standards, preventative maintenance frameworks, vendor governance, and equipment reliability.

In this role, you will take full ownership of our multi-site maintenance strategy across both retail and fulfillment centers. You will bridge the gap between day-to-day warehouse machinery—specifically material handling equipment like forklifts and electric pallet jacks—and broader facility operations like HVAC, fire and life safety, dock doors, janitorial service contracts, and landlord obligations. Moving us from spreadsheets to modern computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS), you will build scalable maintenance playbooks that keep our fulfillment centers and retail stores running without a hitch.

Within your first few months, you’d step into our Jacksonville fulfillment center, take governance of our work order platforms, establish material handling equipment maintenance plans, and align vendor contracts across landlord and tenant responsibilities for both retail and warehouse sites. In a year, you’ll be proud to say you’ve streamlined our facilities operations, established clear service SLAs across national vendors, mitigated operational risks, and built a scalable maintenance foundation to support Article's growth across North America.

Why Article?

As a Particle (people of Article), you will have a high level of autonomy to solve challenging, meaningful problems the best way you can. That means you’re trusted to explore solutions you believe will work best (you’re the expert, after all). You’ll do all this while growing your career within a company that is actively scaling its physical presence.

About the Health, Safety & Facilities Team

You will report to the Compliance and Maintenance Manager as a core member of the Health, Safety & Facilities (HSF) team. You’ll work closely alongside our Safety Specialist team, site leaders, and cross-functional partners across Retail, Fulfillment, Procurement, Legal, and Finance.

Our team operates on a clear boundary model: HSF owns facilities standards, preventative maintenance frameworks, vendor governance, and compliance visibility, while local operational teams maintain line authority over daily site execution. We thrive on a collaborative, first-principles problem-solving culture where systems thinking and proactive communication are key to keeping our team and facilities safe.

This is a hybrid position based out of our Jacksonville, FL fulfillment center (working 3 days on-site and 2 days remotely per week), with open flexibility to support other sites as needed.
data.key_responsibilities:
You will manage the end-to-end multi-site facilities strategy, balancing hands-on equipment and vendor governance with long-term preventative planning.

Specifically, you will:
  • Design & Execute Facilities Strategy: Oversee multi-site preventative and corrective maintenance programs across fulfillment centers, retail showrooms, and offices for building systems including HVAC, dock doors/levelers, fire safety, plumbing, electrical, waste, pest control, and janitorial.
  • Manage Material Handling & Warehouse Equipment: Oversee preventative maintenance, proper site allocation, lifecycle budgeting, and vendor servicing for warehouse machinery, including forklifts, electric pallet jacks, and material handling gear.
  • Govern CMMS & Facility Systems: Own our computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) and work order intake tracking, establishing standards for work order prioritization, escalation, closure, and performance reporting.
  • Lead Vendor Management & SLAs: Partner with Procurement to evaluate, select, and manage third-party vendors. Negotiate scopes, monitor contract SLAs, enforce safety standards, and lead vendor re-bids or transitions when necessary.
  • Assure Safety, Risk & Compliance: Conduct facilities risk assessments, identify safety hazards (egress, trip risks, life safety systems), and enforce timely corrective actions. Initiate stop-work processes in cases of imminent safety risks.
  • Manage Facilities Financials & Budgets: Develop annual maintenance budget inputs, track portfolio spend, evaluate repair-versus-replace options, and authorize routine expenditures within delegated approval limits.
  • Support New Site Readiness: Lead facilities readiness assessments for new store openings, warehouse expansions, closures, or relocations, providing documented recommendations to operational leadership.

  • Systems Thinker & Problem Solver: Meticulous approach to tracking data, spotting recurring facility issues, organizing records, and building durable solutions rather than quick fixes.

Hi there, we’re Article. 👋 We’re a North American-based furniture company creating remarkably better furniture experiences one sofa at a time. And as the Associate Art Director, you’ll play a key role in bringing our products to life through compelling, commercially focused imagery. Based in our Vietnam Photo Studio, you’ll independently art direct product photography, guide studio crews, select final imagery, and ensure every asset reflects Article’s visual standards and product authenticity.


Why We Need You:

As part of our Creative team, you’ll help deliver high-quality product merchandising assets across our digital and physical sales environments. You’ll translate established creative direction, product specifications, and visual merchandising standards into beautifully executed photography.

Working hands-on with photographers, stylists, set builders, and other studio partners, you’ll guide shoots from setup through final image selection, solve day-to-day creative challenges, and ensure our products are represented accurately and consistently.

You’ll also work closely with our Creative team in Vancouver, Canada, keeping communication flowing across locations and helping create a seamless connection between our Vietnam studio and North American teams.


Why Article?

What started in 2019 as a project to strengthen our relationships with our Asian vendors has grown into a permanent operation in Ho Chi Minh City. Article currently has ≈70 employees in Vietnam, across our Sourcing, Technical Product Development, Quality, HR, Logistics, PMO and Accounting functions.

As a Particle (people of Article), you will have a high level of autonomy to solve challenging, meaningful problems the best way you can. That means you’re trusted to explore solutions you believe will work best (you’re the expert, after all). You’ll do all this while growing your skills within a company that is redefining the furniture industry. 

At Article, we grow and have fun together through regular in-office training and team activities. These moments help us build connection, collaboration, and creativity across our teams all year long.
data.key_responsibilities:
You’ll work closely with our Vietnam studio crew and Vancouver Creative team to bring Article products to life through high-quality, commercially focused photography. You’ll take ownership of day-to-day creative execution in the studio, ensuring every image is visually compelling, accurate, and consistent with Article’s brand standards.

  • Lead on-set creative execution by translating established creative direction, product specifications, and visual standards into compelling product photography. Guide photographers, stylists, set builders, and other studio crew members on staging, lighting, styling, and composition.
  • Own image selection and quality control by reviewing captures, selecting final imagery, and providing clear creative and technical feedback to ensure product authenticity, color accuracy, and visual consistency.
  • Solve day-to-day creative and production challenges independently, making confident decisions that keep shoots moving efficiently while maintaining a high standard of creative execution.
  • Collaborate closely with the Vancouver Creative team to align on priorities, communicate production progress, and escalate complex creative challenges when needed. You’ll also provide feedback and recommendations to help evolve our visual guidelines and standards over time.
  • Support a production-ready studio environment by helping maintain and audit set pieces, props, and supporting product inventory while partnering with the broader studio team to deliver consistently high-quality work.
